description_for_human: Create, check and export Azure Migrate server inventories, and create assessments and HA assessments.
description_for_model: Creates or updates an Azure Migrate inventory for the signed-in user (returning an azcopy command the user runs to upload their file), gets the status of an inventory operation, exports the refined inventory or offline zip, creates an assessment followed by an HA assessment, and gets assessment and HA status.

functions.name: azuremigrate_inventory_createorupdate
functions.description: Creates or updates an Azure Migrate inventory and returns an upload command for the user's file plus the session and operation IDs.

functions.name: azuremigrate_inventory_status
functions.description: Gets the current status of an Azure Migrate inventory operation.

functions.name: azuremigrate_inventory_export
functions.description: Gets a download link for the refined inventory or the offline zip of a finished inventory.

functions.name: azuremigrate_assessment_create
functions.description: Creates an Azure Migrate assessment from the collector ZIP with optional settings (savings, hybrid benefit, discount, disks, uptime and more; defaults apply when not given), waits for it and starts the HA assessment.

functions.name: azuremigrate_assessment_status
functions.description: Gets the current status of an Azure Migrate assessment operation.

functions.name: azuremigrate_assessment_hastatus
functions.description: Gets the current status of an HA assessment operation.
